bodyHtml:
What This Is

Shared payment infrastructure enabling different systems (blockchain, card networks, FX platforms) to connect seamlessly via ISO20022 data standards..

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

ISO20022 data standards enabling overlay applications that consolidate identity, compliance and context. India UPI: 15 billion monthly transactions, IMF benchmark for inclusive digital finance. Accenture 2026.

Status
